title: 軌道運輸無障礙月台
summary: 本課聚焦月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑。從月台與車體界限建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把無障礙完整旅程與協助登乘時間連成可驗證的介面，最後以使用性測試推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys. Start with platform and vehicle bounds to define physical or information boundaries, connect complete accessible journey time with assisted boarding time as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from usability trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 月台與車體界限與重複量測與共同偏差
stages.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds & Repeated observations and shared bias
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「月台與車體界限」與「重複量測與共同偏差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Platform and vehicle bounds" and "Repeated observations and shared bias": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台與車體界限」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform and vehicle bounds” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台與車體界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform and vehicle bounds” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台與車體界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform and vehicle bounds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 月台與車體界限
knowledge.text: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「軌道運輸無障礙月台」的「月台與車體界限：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「列車性能與時刻表室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Platform and vehicle bounds: mechanism and system paths” in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Train performance and timetable room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「月台與車體界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Platform and vehicle bounds" is correct?
options: 三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台與車體界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform and vehicle bounds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「月台與車體界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Platform and vehicle bounds", which statement holds?
options: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台與車體界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform and vehicle bounds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。以「月台與車體界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. For platform and vehicle bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把車體位移界 body 從 10 改成 11 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 21 變為 22 mm。先說明「月台與車體界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only body displacement bound body from 10 to 11 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 21 to 22 mm. Explain the causal direction for platform and vehicle bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。以「月台與車體界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. For platform and vehicle bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把車體位移界 body 從 10 改成 11 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 21 變為 22 mm。先說明「月台與車體界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only body displacement bound body from 10 to 11 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 21 to 22 mm. Explain the causal direction for platform and vehicle bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「月台與車體界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Platform and vehicle bounds"?
options: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「月台與車體界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform and vehicle bounds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「月台與車體界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Trace the input chain for platform and vehicle bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「月台與車體界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Trace the input chain for platform and vehicle bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台與車體界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Platform and vehicle bounds" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重複量測與共同偏差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated observations and shared bias: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複量測與共同偏差」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated observations and shared bias” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複量測與共同偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated observations and shared bias” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複量測與共同偏差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repeated observations and shared bias”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複量測與共同偏差
knowledge.text: 本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複量測與共同偏差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repeated observations and shared bias" is correct?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。
optionsEn: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用重複讀值估算分散，再用獨立基準辨認共同偏差，避免重複次數增加帶來虛假的信心。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate spread from repeated readings and use an independent reference to identify shared bias, avoiding false confidence from repetition alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複量測與共同偏差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeated observations and shared bias: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複量測與共同偏差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeated observations and shared bias” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重複量測與共同偏差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repeated observations and shared bias", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複量測與共同偏差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeated observations and shared bias: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複量測與共同偏差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated observations and shared bias” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「重複量測與共同偏差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For repeated observations and shared bias, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「重複量測與共同偏差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for repeated observations and shared bias, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「重複量測與共同偏差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For repeated observations and shared bias, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「重複量測與共同偏差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for repeated observations and shared bias, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複量測與共同偏差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repeated observations and shared bias"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複量測與共同偏差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated observations and shared bias: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複量測與共同偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated observations and shared bias” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「重複量測與共同偏差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for repeated observations and shared bias. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「重複量測與共同偏差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for repeated observations and shared bias. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重複量測與共同偏差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repeated observations and shared bias" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias.
quiz.explanation: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
